**Answer shape:** flat single-repo array of 65 paths — matches the gold's flat `gold` list, no flattening needed. Scorer agreed: `case_family: single-repo`, `gold_schema: verified-no-split`.

The scorer does not emit precision@10/@20, F1@20 or F1_full_list — those keys do not exist in `score_arm.py` (it computes `recall@{10,20,25,50,75}`, `precision@5`, `MRR`, plus the null core/propagation splits). Per the rule against substituting my own arithmetic, I left them out rather than hand-computing.

**Found (19):** RegularBookingService.ts, sendVerifyEmailCode.handler.ts, handlePaymentSuccess.ts, apps/web .../useVerifyEmail.ts, handleConfirmation.ts, confirm.handler.ts, handleBookingRequested.ts, auth/lib/verifyEmail.ts, handleCancelBooking.ts, sendVerifyEmailCode.schema.ts, handleMarkNoShow.ts, EmailWorkflowService.ts, ManagedEventManualReassignmentService.ts, getEventTypesFromDB.ts, payment/getBooking.ts, getBookingToDelete.ts, BookingRepository.ts, VerifyEmailByCode.tsx, BaseScheduledEmail.tsx.

**Missed (12):** `apps/web/modules/bookings/components/BookerWebWrapper.tsx`, `packages/emails/lib/types/email-types.ts`, `packages/emails/templates/attendee-verify-email.ts`, `packages/features/CalendarEventBuilder.ts`, `packages/features/bookings/lib/payment/handleNoShowFee.ts`, `packages/features/di/tokens.ts`, `packages/features/eventtypes/repositories/eventTypeRepository.ts`, `packages/platform/atoms/booker/BookerPlatformWrapper.tsx`, `packages/platform/atoms/hooks/useVerifyEmail.ts`, `packages/trpc/server/routers/loggedInViewer/connectAndJoin.handler.ts`, `packages/trpc/server/routers/viewer/bookings/addGuests.handler.ts`, `packages/types/Calendar.d.ts`.

**Surface verdict: NOT comparable.** Tool calls verified from `commands.log` (40 calls, and they agree with the run's own cost.json this time): stakeout 13, the_receipts 7, shakedown 5, manhunt 4, collateral_damage 4, case_file 2, roll_call/blueprint/rap_sheet 1 each, ToolSearch 2. No filesystem or shell tool was called, every plumbline tool used is inside the arm's `--allowedTools` list (rap_sheet included), and `stakeout` — the retriever's own search tool — was exercised heavily, so the surface itself is clean. The single disqualifier is cost: `cache_read=5,696,371` and `cache_creation=194,106`, i.e. the run was warm, so its $5.59 is not comparable with cold runs in the series. (ToolSearch is exempt from surface purity; it only loads MCP schemas.)

**What the misses share:** they sit at the two ends the run never walked to — the type/wiring register above the handlers (`Calendar.d.ts`, `email-types.ts`, `di/tokens.ts`, `CalendarEventBuilder.ts`, `eventTypeRepository.ts`) and the caller register at the edges (`BookerWebWrapper.tsx`, `BookerPlatformWrapper.tsx`, `platform/atoms/hooks/useVerifyEmail.ts`, `connectAndJoin.handler.ts`, `addGuests.handler.ts`, `handleNoShowFee.ts`). Everything retrieved lives in the middle band: server-side booking/email handlers that literally mention the flag. The platform-atoms duplicates of surfaces that *were* found (the web `useVerifyEmail` hook hit, its atoms twin missed) and the declaration-only files that carry the flag's type rather than a read of it are the recurring shape of the misses.
